solostatus.stat.str.desc: Melee physical damage and power fighting styles.
solostatus.stat.agi.desc: Movement and attack speed, dodge chance, safe fall distance.
solostatus.stat.per.desc: Critical chance and damage, arrow and projectile damage.
solostatus.stat.vit.desc: Max health, damage reduction, resistance to harmful effects.
solostatus.stat.int.desc: Magic power (incl. Iron's Spells), energy pool and regeneration.
solostatus.stat.luck.desc: Extra loot chance and better weapon quality rolls.
solostatus.class.warrior.desc: Melee master. Heavy strikes, charges and war cries. High durability.
solostatus.class.thief.desc: Speed and precision. Evasive dashes, backstabs and invisibility.
solostatus.class.mage.desc: Destruction and control magic. Elemental spells and mana shield.
solostatus.class.defender.desc: The party's wall. Shield bash, taunt, defensive stance and counter.
solostatus.class.archer.desc: Ranged combat. Power shots, volleys, rain of arrows and hunter's mark.
solostatus.class.support.desc: Healing and empowering allies, barriers and cleansing.
solostatus.spec.berserker.desc: The lower your health, the harder you hit. Berserk state with lifesteal.
solostatus.spec.warlord.desc: Area slams and empowering allies after every kill.
solostatus.spec.shadow.desc: Step behind enemies, guaranteed backstab crits, invisibility on kill.
solostatus.spec.blade_dancer.desc: Chained hits with growing damage and an untouchable blade storm.
solostatus.spec.elementalist.desc: Meteor and empowered fire, ice and lightning (incl. Iron's Spells schools).
solostatus.spec.arcanist.desc: Gravity well, cheaper skills and mana, faster recovery.
solostatus.spec.guardian.desc: Protects the party: reduces damage to nearby allies and shields them.
solostatus.spec.juggernaut.desc: Charges through enemies, reflects damage, resists knockback.
solostatus.spec.sharpshooter.desc: Ultra-long shots and bonus damage against distant targets.
solostatus.spec.ranger.desc: Mobility: evasive roll with volley, speed after hits.
solostatus.spec.cleric.desc: Strong healing, holy light against undead, empowered holy magic.
solostatus.spec.enchanter.desc: Hexes enemies and extends buffs on allies.
solostatus.equipment.slot.head: Head
solostatus.counter.undying: Kills on the brink of death
solostatus.skill.power_strike.desc: A heavy blow to the nearest enemy in front: 160% damage (+20% per rank) and strong knockback.
solostatus.skill.warrior_spirit.desc: Passive: +4% melee damage and +1 max health per rank.
solostatus.skill.whirlwind.desc: Spin attack hitting all enemies within 3.5 blocks: 100% damage (+15% per rank).
solostatus.skill.charge.desc: Dash forward with i-frames; on landing deal 120% (+15% per rank) and slow enemies.
solostatus.skill.war_cry.desc: Strength for 8s (+2s per rank, II at rank 4) and Resistance; nearby enemies are weakened.
solostatus.skill.devastating_blow.desc: Crushing blow for 300% (+40% per rank), stuns the target for 1.5s.
solostatus.skill.titan_slash.desc: Ultimate. Wide 6-block cone slash: 500% (+100% per rank). Berserker heals, Warlord grants allies Strength II.
solostatus.skill.quick_dash.desc: Instant dash in your movement direction with 0.4s of invulnerability.
solostatus.skill.ambush.desc: Passive: backstabs deal +10% damage per rank.
solostatus.skill.flurry.desc: A series of 4–6 rapid strikes at the target, 45% each (+5% per rank).
solostatus.skill.vanish.desc: Invisibility for 4s (+1s per rank), enemies lose track of you. Next hit +50%.
solostatus.skill.poison_blade.desc: For 10s your hits poison the target (Poison II from rank 4).
solostatus.skill.assassinate.desc: Strike for 200% (+30% per rank). Triple damage against targets below 30% health.
solostatus.skill.thousand_cuts.desc: Ultimate. 12 hits on all nearby enemies over 1.2s while invulnerable. Shadow becomes invisible afterwards.
solostatus.skill.mana_bolt.desc: Instant 24-block magic ray; damage scales with level and rank.
solostatus.skill.arcane_mind.desc: Passive: +15 max energy and +10% energy regeneration per rank.
solostatus.skill.frost_nova.desc: A wave of cold around you: damage, heavy slow and freezing.
solostatus.skill.flame_burst.desc: A fiery explosion where you look: area damage and burning.
solostatus.skill.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning strikes the target and jumps to 3+rank enemies.
solostatus.skill.mana_shield.desc: Absorbs damage for 10s, stronger with rank.
solostatus.skill.arcane_cataclysm.desc: Ultimate. Three waves of destruction in a 6-block radius. Elementalist ignites, Arcanist pulls enemies in.
solostatus.skill.shield_bash.desc: Stunning strike with strong knockback. +30% damage with a shield equipped.
solostatus.skill.iron_skin.desc: Passive: +1 armor and +2% knockback resistance per rank.
solostatus.skill.taunt.desc: Enemies within 10 blocks (+2 per rank) target you. You gain Resistance.
solostatus.skill.defensive_stance.desc: For 6s (+1s per rank) incoming damage is reduced by 30% (+4% per rank), you are slowed.
solostatus.skill.counter_attack.desc: For 3s the next melee attack against you is negated and answered with a 150% (+30% per rank) strike.
solostatus.skill.fortress.desc: Nearby allies gain Resistance (II from rank 4) and Absorption for 8s.
solostatus.skill.unbreakable.desc: Ultimate. -70% damage taken, all nearby enemies target you, 20% damage reflected. Guardian protects allies, Juggernaut gains Strength II.
solostatus.skill.power_shot.desc: A fast critical arrow with increased damage. No bow required.
solostatus.skill.arrow_volley.desc: A fan of 5+rank arrows in front of you.
solostatus.skill.knockback_shot.desc: An arrow that knocks the target far back.
solostatus.skill.rain_of_arrows.desc: Arrows fall from the sky where you look (10+2×rank arrows).
solostatus.skill.hunters_mark.desc: Marks a target for 10s: glowing and +15% (+3% per rank) damage from you.
solostatus.skill.storm_of_arrows.desc: Ultimate. 3 seconds of arrow rain plus speed. Sharpshooter: stronger arrows, Ranger: wider area.
solostatus.skill.mend.desc: Heals the ally in front of you or yourself: 4 (+1.5 per rank) health, scales with INT.
solostatus.skill.aura_of_vigor.desc: Passive: every 5s allies within 8 blocks recover 0.5 health per rank.
solostatus.skill.blessing.desc: Nearby allies gain Strength and Speed for 10s (+2s per rank).
solostatus.skill.purify.desc: Removes harmful effects from nearby allies and heals them.
solostatus.skill.sanctuary.desc: For 8 seconds a zone heals allies and slows enemies.
solostatus.skill.divine_intervention.des: Ultimate. Nearby allies cannot die for 6s (+1s per rank) and are healed. Cleric cleanses, Enchanter curses enemies.
solostatus.skill.berserk.desc: 10s (+1s per rank): +20% damage (+5% per rank), 10% lifesteal, but +15% damage taken.
solostatus.skill.blood_rage.desc: Passive: damage grows as you lose health (up to +6% per rank).
solostatus.skill.earthbreaker.desc: Ground slam: area damage, launches enemies, grants allies Resistance.
solostatus.skill.commander.desc: Passive: each kill grants you and nearby allies Strength for 2s+rank.
solostatus.skill.shadow_step.desc: Teleport behind the target and backstab for 210% (+30% per rank).
solostatus.skill.shadow_veil.desc: Passive: after a kill gain invisibility and speed for 1s+rank.
solostatus.skill.blade_storm.desc: Three consecutive blade whirls while invulnerable.
solostatus.skill.blade_rhythm.desc: Passive: each hit in a chain empowers the next (up to 5 stacks).
solostatus.skill.meteor.desc: After 0.75s a meteor crashes where you look: huge damage and burning.
solostatus.skill.elemental_attunement.de: Passive: +6% to system elemental magic and +3% Iron's fire, ice and lightning power per rank.
solostatus.skill.gravity_well.desc: For 2 seconds pulls enemies to a point, dealing damage and slowing.
solostatus.skill.arcane_flow.desc: Passive: skills cost 6% less per rank; Iron's Spells mana regen +5%.
solostatus.skill.aegis.desc: Nearby allies gain Resistance II and Absorption.
solostatus.skill.bulwark.desc: Passive: shield blocks grant Absorption; nearby allies take 3% less damage per rank.
solostatus.skill.seismic_charge.desc: Charge forward, knocking back and launching everything in your path.
solostatus.skill.thorns_body.desc: Passive: reflects 6% of melee damage and grants +5% knockback resistance per rank.
solostatus.skill.sniper_shot.desc: An ultra-fast arrow with no drop and huge damage.
solostatus.skill.deadeye.desc: Passive: +8% damage per rank against targets beyond 20 blocks.
solostatus.skill.evasive_roll.desc: Leap back with i-frames and fire three arrows.
solostatus.skill.fleet_foot.desc: Passive: +3% speed per rank, speed boost after arrow hits.
solostatus.skill.holy_light.desc: Heals nearby allies and burns undead.
solostatus.skill.divine_grace.desc: Passive: healing +10% per rank; Iron's holy and nature power +4%.
solostatus.skill.hex.desc: Curses a target for 8s: weakness, slowness, glowing and increased damage taken.
solostatus.skill.resonance.desc: Passive: your buffs last 15% longer per rank; hits may weaken enemies.
solostatus.skill.sprint.desc: A burst of speed for 5s (+1s per rank).
solostatus.skill.appraisal.desc: Lets you study other hunters: mastery, equipment and some skills. Higher rank reveals more.
solostatus.skill.bloodlust.desc: An aura of killing intent: nearby enemies are slowed and weakened, weak ones flee.
solostatus.skill.cross_slash.desc: Two swift sword slashes at all enemies in front of you.
solostatus.skill.vital_strike.desc: Your next hit within 6s is a guaranteed critical, +50% damage and poison.
solostatus.skill.sunder.desc: An axe strike that makes the target take 15% (+3% per rank) more damage for 8s.
solostatus.skill.piercing_thrust.desc: A spear thrust hitting all enemies in a 6-block line.
solostatus.skill.ground_pound.desc: A mace slam that stuns and slows enemies around you. Crowd control for heavy weapons.
solostatus.skill.perfect_guard.desc: Passive: blocking right after raising your shield stuns the attacker and returns 30% (+10% per rank) damage.
solostatus.skill.counter_edge.desc: Passive: a hit within 2s after a block or dodge deals +10% damage per rank.
solostatus.skill.afterimage.desc: Passive: after a dodge gain speed (and invisibility from rank 3).
solostatus.skill.tenacity.desc: Passive: below 30% health, damage taken is reduced by 5% per rank.
solostatus.skill.tenacity.hint: Strength born on the edge of death...
solostatus.skill.second_wind.desc: Passive: lethal damage leaves you alive with some health (once per 5/4/3 minutes).
solostatus.skill.second_wind.hint: One who survived once will learn not to die.
solostatus.skill.ruler_grip.desc: An invisible force lifts the target and slams it down. Reward of the hidden achievement "Sovereign".
solostatus.skill.ruler_grip.hint: A power worthy of a ruler awaits the one who defeats the mightiest.
solostatus.achievement.undying.desc: Defeat an enemy with 1 heart or less.
solostatus.achievement.untouchable.desc: Defeat 25 strong enemies without taking damage in the last 30 seconds.

solostatus.skill.blade_flash.desc: A lightning dash through enemies in a 6-block line: 150% damage (+20% per rank) to each, invulnerable while dashing.
solostatus.skill.titan_grip.desc: Passive: greatsword hits have a 5% chance per rank to stun — heavy weapons stagger.
solostatus.skill.frost_arrow.desc: An arrow that freezes and heavily slows the target.
solostatus.skill.explosive_bolt.desc: A bolt that explodes on hit, damaging enemies within 2.5 blocks.
solostatus.skill.arcane_blast.desc: A magical burst around you: damage and knockback within 4 blocks.
solostatus.skill.hunter_sense.desc: Passive: hostile creatures within 10 blocks (+3 per rank) are highlighted.
solostatus.skill.regeneration.desc: Passive: out of combat, restores 0.5 health per rank every 5 seconds.
solostatus.skill.mana_blade.desc: For 8s your next 4+rank weapon hits deal bonus magic damage.
solostatus.skill.rampage.desc: Passive: three kills within 10 seconds grant Strength and Speed.
solostatus.skill.rampage.hint: One who never stops becomes a storm.
solostatus.skill.shadow_legion.desc: Summons 2+rank/2 shadow wolf allies for 30 seconds. Reward of the hidden achievement "Legion".
solostatus.skill.shadow_legion.hint: Those who fell by your hand will one day answer your call.
solostatus.achievement.frenzy.desc: Enter a rampage 50 times (3 kills in 10 seconds).

solostatus.achievement.deep_dark.title: Title: immunity to Darkness and Blindness.
solostatus.achievement.mastery_50.title: Title: +5% damage with a weapon at mastery 50.
solostatus.achievement.bone_lord.title: Title: +10% damage against undead.
solostatus.achievement.night_hunter.titl: Title: at night +8% damage and night vision.
solostatus.achievement.undying.title: Title: Regeneration while below 30% health.
solostatus.achievement.untouchable.title: Title: +5% dodge chance.
solostatus.achievement.giant_killer.titl: Title: +15% damage against targets with twice your max health.

solostatus.achievement.solo_raid.desc: Defeat a boss with no other hunters nearby.
solostatus.achievement.legion.desc: Defeat three different bosses and 2000 enemies.
solostatus.achievement.sovereign.desc: Defeat the Ender Dragon and the Wither.

solostatus.skill.parry.desc: A 0.4–0.8 s window: the next melee blow is turned aside and the attacker is staggered (a boss is only pushed back). Opens the counter window.
solostatus.skill.acrobatics.desc: Passive: +1 block of safe fall per rank.
solostatus.skill.body_reinforcement.desc: Pour your resource into muscle and skin: Strength I and Resistance I for 8/10/12 s, plus Speed I at rank 3.
solostatus.skill.iron_will.desc: Passive: +4% resistance to harmful effects per rank.
solostatus.skill.air_step.desc: Kick off the air itself: a leap from the ground or a second jump in mid-air. Resets fall distance.
solostatus.skill.breathing_technique.des: Passive: mana or stamina recovers 8% faster per rank.
solostatus.skill.focus.desc: For 6/7/8 s your blows find weak points: +10/15/20% crit chance.
solostatus.skill.weapon_adept.desc: Passive: weapon mastery grows 5% faster per rank.
solostatus.skill.danger_sense.desc: Passive: 5% chance per rank to evade a projectile.
solostatus.skill.thought_acceleration.de: The world slows down: Speed II and Haste II for 3/4/5 s, nearby enemies get Slowness II (weaker and shorter on bosses).
solostatus.skill.overwhelming_presence.d: Enemies weaker than you lose their nerve: Weakness, Slowness II and they stop chasing. Strong ones are only slowed, bosses ignore it. Radius 7–9 blocks.
solostatus.accessory.wear_hint.ring: Right click — wear in a System slot (up to 2 rings)
solostatus.accessory.wear_hint.amulet: Right click — wear in a System slot (1 amulet)
solostatus.ui.jewellery_hint: Wear rings and amulets with right click or in Curios slots. 2 rings and 1 amulet count.
solostatus.notice.awakened.desc: The System has chosen you. Open the System window and choose a class.
solostatus.notice.awakened.desc_class: The System is with you again.
